causalBasis.save: The draft is filled before drop without a prior saved-host receipt. Actual 800 ms/zero/backoff work can overlap offline. Current text/edit must have a positive acknowledged host revision and no saving/bind/uncertainty/conflict/failure/device-only state. Busy serialization and host-sequence checks exclude stale save/list/get publication. A same-content refresh acknowledgement uses the single admitted listing; it is not proof that every timer is cleared.
causalBasis.history: Actual current-socket initial resume sends plus the connect snapshot are admitted to the original held backend gate before old completion. Quiet keeps its first turn and uses no newer-result resync. Later original release/status assertions remain.
causalBasis.send: Answer-delivery connected() replays ask-answer status/responses, never chat_message. Fresh context/no asks supplies no answer submissions. The original session_info receipt precedes opening text; accepted sends are not made unconfirmed by disconnect. Chat resend requires the explicit user action. The unchanged final net.sent oracle remains, rather than inferring absence from turnRetries alone.
causalBasis.nativeWork: Initial restoreDone is awaited without flushing. This single fresh context has no foreign native writer or device action. Context writes may still run; native storage, focus/selection and the captured-history release retain the original final negative windows. Finite rendering is a separate preparation, not a persistence drain.
